label: Portrait screen — DOCUMENTED STUB, NOT IMPLEMENTED
description: Portrait totems and window displays. This file documents the intended contract; scripts/render-frames.mjs and the templates do not implement it yet. A build with this profile fails with a clear message rather than producing a broken video.

blockers: the menu-board template geometry is landscape-only: the item rows and the hero panel are placed with absolute pixel positions
item capacity drops to 2-3 at the 48 px item-name floor, so the compiler needs a paging plan (rotate items across the loop) instead of shrinking type
the legal strip needs a second layout pass: 32 px text over 1080 px width wraps differently
